quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): NVIDIA and the UW Medicine Institute for Protein Design released RFD4-Proteina, an open NVIDIA BioNeMo protein design model available through partners including Amazon Bio Discovery, Anthropic's Claude Science, Benchling, Databricks, Google Cloud, Hugging Face, Nebius, OpenAI and Tamarind Bio; Automata, Benchling, Biolevate, Boltz, Hologen and Therna Biosciences are using BioNeMo to build scientific agents, and Genedata's AI co-scientist will use RFD4-Proteina in Danaher's autonomous lab. Siemens Healthineers is collaborating with NVIDIA on adaptive radiotherapy, with Nemotron models being explored for agentic co-planning.
